rationale: Although the stock has rallied strongly off its $37.00 low to trade near the top of its intraday range above VWAP ($39.20) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($41.27), it faces severe broad-market headwinds with SPY down over 4% and VIXY up 24%. With only 24 minutes remaining before mandatory liquidation and a 14.5 bps bid-ask spread eating into potential edge relative to the $0.43 5-minute ATR, neither direction offers an attractive risk-reward profile.
